title: Compare dot product and oriented area
caption: Move b while a stays on the horizontal axis. Compare alignment, the signed cross-product component, and the nonnegative area.
accessibleSummary: An equal-scale coordinate plane shows a = (2, 0) and an adjustable b. Component controls update the dot product 2bx, the perpendicular cross product (0, 0, 2by), and parallelogram area |2by|. Zero input has no angle.
